title: 第19章 宠辱不惊他依旧在第20章 深夜密谋打压林家
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“咦，怎么回事，刘柯为何不动？”
“他的掌法明明已经袭击到林晨。”
“对面的林晨也不动，到底什么情况？”
众多围观的人，不少人都满脸错愕。
他们看着刘柯气势汹涌，朝着林晨动手。
眼看着双掌，已经袭击到林晨，刘柯却突然停下来。
“刚才那一剑，毫无灵力波动，到底是怎么做到的呢？”
人群里面的胡一水，苍老的双眸深处，浮现出震惊。
他的内心都是震撼和错愕。
林晨刚才施展出来的那一剑，就算是他也没看清楚，具体怎么施展出来的。
他只知道，对面的刘柯已经死了。
因为，
林晨一剑，将他的身体拦腰斩断，没有丝毫拖泥带水。
他感受到刘柯身上的生机，已经彻底消散。
“这个少年看起来不过十五六岁，数日之前清幽山传授我《拈花十三剑》的神秘强者，难道是他吗？”
胡一水刚才听到林晨的声音，的确听起来有些熟悉。
可，
要让他将一个十五六岁的少年，与清幽山传授他《拈花十三剑》的神秘强者联系起来。
他实在是有些不敢置信。
最重要的是，他从林晨的身上，感受不到任何灵力的气息。

只不过，他见到方才林晨施展出来的那一剑。
他的内心又开始动摇了。
“这个小镇的林家，现在看来，有古怪啊。”
胡一水也不是寻常之辈。
他感受的很清楚。
无论是林明义，以及林毅，还有林山等人，身上的灵力气息，几乎都是相同的，而且很霸道。
也就是说，他们修炼的功法，至少也是玄级功法。
这样偏远的小镇，仅仅只有通神境坐镇小家族，哪里来的玄级功法。
他的内心越发的好奇。
“若是能够招揽到这两个青年，成为归元剑宗的弟子，兴许是我们归元剑宗在大衍皇朝崛起的机会啊。”
想到这里，胡一水看向林晨和林雨菲的眼神，都变的火热起来。
旋即他看向林晨，也是忍不住摇摇头：“就不知道将来能不能开脉？”
“好快的剑法。”
康允也是忍不住站起身来，微微眯着双眼，盯着林晨。
想要从其身上看出一些端倪。
却发现。
从始至终，林晨都神色淡然，显然没有将一剑斩杀刘柯的事情，放在心上，只当是寻常。
“柯儿！
content_en:
"Hey, what's going on? Why doesn't Liu Ke move?"
"His palm technique has clearly hit Lin Chen."
"Lin Chen on the other side didn't move. What's going on?"
Many of the people who were watching had expressions of astonishment.
They watched Liu Ke become fierce and move towards Lin Chen.
Seeing that his palms had already attacked Lin Chen, Liu Ke suddenly stopped.
"That sword strike just now had no spiritual power fluctuations. How did you do it?"
Hu Yishui in the crowd showed shock in the depths of his old eyes.
He was shocked and stunned inside.
Even he didn't see clearly how Lin Chen used the sword just now.
He only knew that Liu Ke on the opposite side was dead.
Because,
Lin Chen cut his body in half with a sword, without any hesitation.
He felt that the vitality in Liu Ke's body had completely dissipated.
"This young man looks to be only fifteen or sixteen years old. Is he the mysterious strong man who taught me the "Thirteen Nianhua Swords" in Qingyoushan a few days ago?"
Hu Yishui heard Lin Chen's voice just now, and it did sound familiar.
Yes,
He was asked to connect a fifteen or sixteen-year-old boy with the mysterious strong man who taught him the "Thirteen Nianhua Swords" in Qingyou Mountain.
He was really in disbelief.
The most important thing was that he couldn't feel any spiritual energy from Lin Chen's body.
However, he saw the sword that Lin Chen had used just now.
His heart began to waver again.
"The Lin family in this small town looks weird now."
Hu Yishui is not an ordinary person.
He felt it clearly.
Whether it is Lin Mingyi, Lin Yi, Lin Shan and others, the aura of spiritual power on their bodies is almost the same, and they are very domineering.
In other words, the techniques they practice are at least Xuan-level techniques.
In such a remote town, there is only a small family in the Tongshen realm, so where can the Xuan-level skills come from.
He became more and more curious.
"If we can recruit these two young men to become disciples of the Guiyuan Sword Sect, it may be an opportunity for our Guiyuan Sword Sect to rise in the Dayan Dynasty."
Thinking of this, Hu Yishui's eyes turned hot when he looked at Lin Chen and Lin Yufei.
Immediately he looked at Lin Chen and couldn't help but shake his head: "I wonder if I can open my pulse in the future?"
"What a fast swordsmanship."
Kang Yun couldn't help but stand up, squinting his eyes slightly and staring at Lin Chen.
I want to get some clues from it.
But found out.
From the beginning to the end, Lin Chen looked indifferent. He obviously did not take the matter of killing Liu Ke with a sword to his heart, and just regarded it as ordinary.
"Ke'er!
